# Heirmos

> Heirmos is memory for coding agents. A Claude Code plugin (and Codex / Cursor integrations) captures the durable decisions, preferences and context from each session and hands them back as a briefing when the next session starts — so a decision made in Claude Code on Monday is known to Codex on Tuesday. The same memory is readable from Claude.ai and ChatGPT over MCP. Korean-first, free to use.
> Heirmos 는 코딩 에이전트의 기억입니다. Claude Code 플러그인(Codex · Cursor 연동 포함)이 세션의 결정·선호·맥락을 자동으로 남기고, 다음 세션 시작에 브리핑으로 돌려줍니다 — 월요일 Claude Code 에서 정한 것을 화요일 Codex 가 압니다. 같은 기억을 MCP 로 Claude.ai · ChatGPT 에서도 읽습니다. 한국어 우선, 무료.

## What it does / 무엇을 하나

- Session start: `heirmos briefing` injects this repo's recent decisions plus older memories relevant to the task (≤ ~1 500 tokens) into the agent's context.
- Pre-compaction / session end: `heirmos capture` sends only the user's prompts and the agent's prose (no tool output, file contents or thinking), with credential-shaped strings redacted client-side; the server keeps only durable facts, decisions and preferences.
- Hooks never block a session: no CLI, no key or no network means a silent exit.
- Cross-agent: Claude Code, Codex (AGENTS.md + MCP) and Cursor (rules) share one memory; Claude.ai and ChatGPT connect over MCP.
- Memories are a folder tree of markdown notes with hybrid search (embeddings + keywords, tuned for Korean), versioning with soft delete and strict per-user isolation.
- 세션 시작 브리핑 · 컴팩트 직전/세션 종료 자동 캡처(대화 글만, 기기에서 키 리댁션) · 세션을 막지 않음 · Claude Code / Codex / Cursor 공유 기억.

## Install (Claude Code)

1. `uv tool install heirmos-cli` (PyPI, MIT, depends only on httpx)
2. Sign in at https://dashboard.heirmos.com, mint an API key under Account → API keys, `export HEIRMOS_API_KEY="hk_..."`
3. In Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace add team-pneumora/pneumora-plugins` then `/plugin install heirmos@pneumora-plugins`

## Endpoints

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP): https://mcp.heirmos.com/mcp
- REST API: https://api.heirmos.com (Bearer `hk_…` keys issued in the dashboard)
- Dashboard / sign-up (Google login): https://dashboard.heirmos.com
- CLI: https://pypi.org/project/heirmos-cli/
